# TestScript for 32-implicit-command
# Asserts Bun-style implicit execution and help rendering.

# 1. Bare invocation runs the parent Runner, which prints help.
exec implicit-command
stdout 'Usage:\n  implicit-command \[<command>\]'
stdout 'run\s+Execute a file \(default\)'
stdout 'install\s+Install dependencies'

# 2. An unmatched operand enters the implicit command.
exec implicit-command ./script.ts one two
stdout 'run file=script.ts dry-run=false args=\[one two\]'

# 3. Explicit naming is equivalent.
exec implicit-command run ./script.ts
stdout 'run file=script.ts dry-run=false args=\[\]'

# 4. The implicit child's flag binds before the operand.
exec implicit-command -n ./script.ts
stdout 'run file=script.ts dry-run=true args=\[\]'

# 5. Explicit siblings win.
exec implicit-command install
stdout 'install frozen=false'

# 6. A flag belonging only to the implicit child is invalid on a sibling.
exit-status 2 implicit-command -n install
stderr 'unknown flag: -n'

# 7. Help stays parent-scoped at a bare --help request.
exec implicit-command --help
stdout 'Usage:\n  implicit-command \[<command>\]'
stdout 'run\s+Execute a file \(default\)'
stdout '--version'

# 8. The terminator forwards dash-prefixed operands to the implicit command.
exec implicit-command -- -e.ts
stdout 'run file=-e.ts dry-run=false args=\[\]'

# 9. A builtin request before the terminator keeps parent help scope.
exec implicit-command --help -- ignored.ts
stdout 'Usage:\n  implicit-command \[<command>\]'

# 10. A child-only flag selects the implicit command without an operand.
exit-status 2 implicit-command -n
stderr 'missing required positional argument <file>'

# 11. Help follows the flag-selected implicit child.
exec implicit-command -n --help
stdout 'Usage:\n  implicit-command run'
! stdout '--version'

# 12. --version is root-only: a child-only flag selects the child and rejects it.
exit-status 2 implicit-command -n --version
stderr 'unknown flag: --version'

# 13. After the operand fills the positionals, --version is a raw argument,
# exactly like the named form.
exec implicit-command ./script.ts --version
stdout 'run file=script.ts dry-run=false args=\[--version\]'
exec implicit-command run ./script.ts --version
stdout 'run file=script.ts dry-run=false args=\[--version\]'

# 14. Explicit naming keeps --version root-only.
exit-status 2 implicit-command run --version
stderr 'unknown flag: --version'

# 15. Naming the child anywhere keeps --version unknown, even before the flag.
exit-status 2 implicit-command --version run
stderr 'unknown flag: --version'

# 16. The bare root invocation accepts it.
exec implicit-command --version
stdout 'implicit-command has version 1.0.0'
